verdict.rationale: Obsidian's core architecture stores notes as plain-text Markdown files locally (obsidian-docs-20, obsidian-docs-23), explicitly marketed as non-proprietary for longevity and vendor independence, with community corroboration that notes 'can outlive the app itself' (obsidian-comm-19) and are more future-proof than competitors (obsidian-comm-3). Canvas files add an open-sourced JSON format (obsidian-comm-14), though community members note some concern this could drift from pure Markdown (obsidian-comm-15). Missing for 10: independent long-term archival testing or third-party audits confirming format stability over years, and any note on export completeness for non-Markdown metadata (e.g., plugin data).
